title: Understanding Stability of Outer Nesterov Momentum on Stochastic Pseudo-Gradients
abstract: arXiv:2610.22623v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large neural networks are commonly trained across many workers, and communication between them is a major cost. Workers therefore take several local optimization steps before sending their net parameter displacements, or pseudo-gradients, to an outer optimizer, which often applies Nesterov momentum. We study how the outer momentum, the number of local steps and the averaging over workers control the training dynamics, and in particular their stability. For random quadratics, we derive an exact mean-square stability criterion in any dimension, which reveals that the inner batch size determines whether increasing the number of local steps eventually stabilizes or destabilizes the outer iteration. Moreover, while averaging the pseudo-gradients of independent workers can make larger outer momentum values admissible, the number of workers required for stability can grow exponentially with the number of local steps. translated_title: 理解外层Nesterov动量在随机伪梯度上的稳定性
translated_abstract: 大型神经网络通常在多个工作节点上分布式训练，而节点间的通信是主要开销。因此，工作节点在向采用Nesterov动量的外层优化器发送其净参数位移（即伪梯度）之前，会先执行若干局部优化步骤。我们研究外层动量、局部步数以及工作节点间平均操作如何控制训练动态，特别是其稳定性。对于随机二次函数，我们在任意维度上推导出精确的均方稳定性准则，该准则揭示了内部批大小决定了增加局部步数最终会使外层迭代变得更稳定还是更不稳定。此外，尽管对独立工作节点的伪梯度取平均可以容许更大的外层动量取值，但满足稳定性所需的工作节点数量可能随局部步数呈指数级增长。最后，我们表明……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文推导出随机伪梯度下外层Nesterov动量的精确均方稳定性准则，揭示内部批大小决定了局部步数增加会使训练稳定或不稳定，且稳定性所需的工作节点数量可能随局部步数呈指数级增长。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an exact mean-square stability criterion for outer Nesterov momentum on stochastic pseudo-gradients, revealing that the inner batch size determines whether increasing local steps stabilizes or destabilizes training, and that the number of workers required for stability can grow exponentially with the number of local steps.
